test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Why is teaching confined to short periods?

options.text: Because children need to participate in physical activities
Because children cannot sit with concentration beyond their span of interest
Because children can learn more concepts
Because children need to participate in co circular activities

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Teaching is confined** to short periods because children have a natural attention span that is limited.
 
• The **passage mentions** that teaching at Shikshayatan is tailored to the natural attention span of each child, which is typically 15-30 minutes daily during the first two years.
 
• **It is important **to align teaching with the child's span of interest to maintain their engagement and concentration.
 
• **By keeping the teaching periods short**, the teachers ensure that the children can focus and learn effectively within their attention capacity.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:* 'Because children cannot sit with concentration beyond their span of interest'.*
